scripts.text:
^008800Wait here!!
You're carrying too much stuff. Why don't you put some of it away, and then come back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800请留步！
你带的东西太多了，先存放一些再来吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Sigh... I don't know if I can ever go back to sailing the sea...
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
唉... 不知道还能不能再次扬帆出海...

scripts.text: ^0000ffLooking incredibly excited, the old man ran into the marine shop hurriedly ordering goods. You don't have anything better to do, so you decide to ask him why he is in such a rush.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff老人满脸兴奋，匆匆跑进海产店订购货物。你正好没事做，便决定问问他为什么这么着急。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe old man, after finishing his orders, walks towards you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff老人订完货后，向你走了过来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
I was touched when you accepted a request from me, a stranger, so easily. You must truly be one of those good, heroic adventurers. Are you interested in setting out on an ocean voyage?
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
我们素不相识，你却这么爽快地答应帮忙，我真是感动。
你一定是位心地善良、英勇无畏的冒险者。
有没有兴趣出海远航？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've sailed a few times... But now that I think about it, I've never gone across the continent.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
出海过几次... 不过仔细想想，还从没去过大陆以外的地方。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
No, that's good enough. I may just have one small fishing vessel, but I used to be a captain that commanded a fleet.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
没关系，足够了。
我现在虽然只有一艘小渔船，以前却是指挥整支舰队的船长。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
As you may know after a few sea voyages, not many people have gone across the ocean beyond the continent. I too have failed to conquer the ocean.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
出海过几次，你应该也知道，很少有人能跨越大陆之外的大洋。
我也没能征服那片海。

scripts.text: ^0000ffMr. Janssen talked about his perilous ocean journeys for quite a while. You have enough time on your hands, so you sit down, quietly listening to his story.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff扬森先生滔滔不绝地讲述了他惊险的海上旅程。你正好有空，便坐下来静静地听他讲述。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffAt least half of his story sounded grossly exaggerated, but something caught your ear: he insists that a humongous tower exists on the ocean, and that it's so tall, it scrapes across the sky.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff他故事里至少有一半听起来夸张得离谱，但有一点引起了你的注意：他坚持说海洋上有一座巨大的塔，高得仿佛要刺破天空。^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
So all I could do was cast anchor at that humongous tower after my fleet was wrecked. At first, we were only going to stay there until the rainstorm was over, but it didn't end as soon as we had hoped.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
船队遇难后，我们只能在那座巨塔旁抛锚。
本想等暴风雨停了就走，可它迟迟没有停下来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
My crew was starving, and a few of them walked into the tower in order to find food... They never came back.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
船员们饿得受不了了，有几个人进塔找吃的...
可他们再也没回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why didn't you go in there with them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为什么不和他们一起进去？

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
My instincts told me that tower was dangerous. I was curious, but I wasn't going to risk my life. We waited for them to come back for 7 days until the rainstorm was finally over, but no one returned.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
直觉告诉我那座塔很危险。
虽然好奇，我也不想拿命冒险。
我们等了七天，暴风雨终于停了，却还是没有人回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
In our desperation to survive, we abandoned all our goods, and left the tower only with a little bit of the water and edible plants we'd found around the tower. When we finally reached land, I was the only one alive...
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
为了活下去，我们扔掉了所有货物，只带着在塔周围找到的一点水和能吃的植物离开。
等终于抵达陆地时，只剩我一个人活着...

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou could imagine the heartwretching scene of the dying fleet on their last voyage, even if he didn't explain it any further. A look of somber regret swept over his face as he remained silent a while, and then he said:^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff即使他没有进一步解释，你也能想象出那支垂死船队在最后一次航行中的悲惨景象。他沉默了一会儿，脸上掠过一丝沉重的悔恨，然后说道：^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
I have something I must do before I die. I must retrieve the remains of my crew that died in the tower, and give them a proper burial.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
死之前，有件事我必须完成。
我要找回死在塔里的船员的遗骸，让他们入土为安。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
I feel so lucky to meet a warm-hearted adventurer like you. With the money you've given me, I can finally go sailing to the tower again.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
能遇到你这么热心的冒险者，真是我的幸运。
有了你给的钱，我终于能再次出海，前往那座塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about hiring me as your first mate?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不如雇我当你的大副吧？

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Thank you, but it is an extremely dangerous place. I have my duty to fulfill, but you don't have any obligation to me or them. I don't wish to sacrifice someone as young as you to such a dangerous place.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
谢谢你，可那里太危险了。
我有必须履行的责任，你却不欠我和他们什么。
我不想让你这么年轻的人在那里丢了性命。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No...
.
.
As an adventurer, there's my obligation to those in need. I'm also very curious about that place...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...
.
.
身为冒险者，我有责任帮助需要帮助的人。
而且，我也很好奇那个地方...

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
I was going to leave right away, but since you've joined me, I should give you time to prepare. I'll be waiting here until you're ready to go.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
我本来打算马上出发，不过既然你要同行，总得给你时间准备。
我就在这里等你，准备好了再走。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
...Okay then...
Welcome aboard, first mate.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
...好吧...
欢迎登船，大副。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Shall we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
我们现在出发吗？

scripts.text: Yes, let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧

scripts.text: No, I'm not quite ready...
scripts.translation: 还没准备好...

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Then pull up the anchor, first mate!
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
那就起锚吧，大副！

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Sure, no problem. Come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
当然，没问题。等你准备好了再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Well, to travel the ocean again, we need to restock on goods. If you give me 10,000 Zeny, I'll take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
再次出海前，需要补充物资。
给我 10,000 Zeny，其他事就交给我吧。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再来

scripts.text: Let's go, now!
scripts.translation: 现在就走

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but I don't have that much money. I'll come back when I save enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我没有那么多钱。等我攒够了再回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Sure, no problem. I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
当然，没问题。我会在这里等你回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough money. I need at least 10,000 Zeny to restock our supplies...
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
抱歉，你的钱还不够。
补充物资至少需要 10,000 Zeny...

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Excellent! Now we're good to go. Let's pull up the anchor again!
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
太好了！现在我们可以出发了。让我们再次起锚吧！

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Excuse me, are you an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
打扰一下，你是冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
I'm sorry to ask you this, especially when this is the first time we've ever met, but can you do me a favor? I'll make it short.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
初次见面就开口求助，实在不好意思。
能帮我一个忙吗？
我长话短说。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Can you donate ^0000ff10,000 Zeny^000000 to me? It's for a cause that's important to me...
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
能资助我^0000ff10,000 Zeny^000000吗？
我有件很重要的事要做...

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不行

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you've got the wrong person to ask that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，你问错人了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
I see... Sorry to bother you. I understand it was too rude to ask something like that to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
这样啊... 抱歉打扰了。
一见面就提这种要求，确实太失礼了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Huh? Are you sure that you don't mind giving me that much money? Wow, thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
咦？你确定不介意给我这么多钱吗？哇，太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
...I'm sorry, but I don't think you have 10,000 Zeny. Thank you for your kindness, but I need more than that.
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
... 抱歉，你似乎没有 10,000 Zeny。
谢谢你的好意，不过这些还不够。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know why you'd need so much money, but here. You can take it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道你为什么需要这么多钱，不过，拿去吧。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou have donated 10,000 Zeny to Captain Janssen^000000.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你给了扬森船长 10,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Janssen]
Thank you so much! Now I can stock up on food and materials for my ship. You're kind, very kind!
scripts.translation:
[船长 扬森]
太感谢了！这下能为船上备好食物和物资了。
你真是个好人！

还需等待 {0} 小时 {1} 分钟 {2} 秒才能再次进入。

scripts.translation: 这里很危险。让我把你传送到艾尔贝塔。

记忆地下城“无尽之塔”不存在。
队长尚未创建地下城。

scripts.text:
- A Message is Engraved on the Brazier -
The one who scatters the ashes of the darkness in this place shall become one step closer to Naght Sieger, the Hegemon King of the Darkness...
scripts.translation:
- 火盆上刻着一段话 -
在此撒下黑暗材料之人，将更接近黑暗霸主——夜胜魔 纳户特基格...

（例如：26F->26，50F->50）

(i.g.: 51F->51, 75F->75)

这个 NPC 管理第 51 至 75 层。
请输入要开启的层数。
（例如：51F->51，75F->75）

scripts.translation: 您只能输入51到75之间的数字。

Please enter the Level number to open.
(i.g.: 76F->76, 99F->99)
scripts.translation:
这个 NPC 管理第 76 至 99 层。
请输入要开启的层数。
（例如：76F->76，99F->99）

scripts.text: You can only enter a number from 76 to 99.
scripts.translation: 您只能输入76到99之间的数字。

scripts.text: *** Level {0} is now being opened. ***
^0000ffA mysterious voice echoes through the room as you touch the lucid crystal radiating a strong light.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff当你触碰散发着强光的清澈水晶时，一个神秘的声音在房间里回荡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
Welcome to my place, intruders. I've had fun watching you endure all the difficulties I've set before you.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
欢迎来到我的领地，入侵者。
看着你们苦苦闯过我设下的难关，真是有趣。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
Unfortunately, the time has come to end the show.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
可惜，这场好戏该落幕了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
It's still too early to celebrate your victory against my right-hand man Knothen because he isn't completely destroyed!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
打败了我的心腹诺森，就急着庆祝？
还早呢，他可没被彻底消灭！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
I shall resurrect him for your next show. Defeat him again, and then I'll gladly accept your challenge.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
我会让他复活，陪你们再演一场。
再打败他一次，我就欣然接受你们的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
Good-bye for now.
Once again, I had such a great time, humans. I look forward to seeing you again.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
暂且别过吧。
人类，你们又让我尽兴了一回。
期待再次见到你们。

scripts.text: ^0000ffAs soon as the voice stopped talking, an irresistible force lifted and moved you somewhere else.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff声音停止的那一刻，一股不可抗拒的力量将你举起并带到了别处。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe radiating crystal piece seems to beckon you, just like last time.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff散发着光芒的水晶碎片似乎在召唤你，就像上次一样。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
I must have underestimated you... I didn't expect to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
看来我低估了你们... 没想到还能再见面。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
I can smell your sweat, hear the gasps of your exhaustion in combat. Ah~ The human desire for victory always excites me.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
我闻得到你们的汗味，也听得到你们激战后疲惫的喘息。
啊~ 人类对胜利的渴望，总是让我兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Voice]
I now allow you to come receive an audience from me. Come to me, to Naght Sieger the Hegemon-King of the Darkness!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的声音]
现在，我准许你们前来觐见。
来吧，来到我——黑暗霸主夜胜魔 纳户特基格的面前！

scripts.text: This NPC manages the crystal on the 100th Level. Please enter the password.
scripts.translation:
这个 NPC 管理第 100 层的水晶。
请输入密码。

scripts.text: The 100th Level's crystal has been activated.
scripts.translation: 第100层的水晶已被激活。

scripts.text: Please enter the correct password.
scripts.translation: 请输入正确的密码。

scripts.text: ^0066ffYou took a sip of the spring's clear water, and you feel invigorated.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0066ff你喝了一口清澈的泉水，顿时精神一振。^000000

scripts.text: You're carrying too much stuff. Why don't you put some of it away, and then come back?
scripts.translation: 你带的东西太多了，先存放一些再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
It's you that have liberated us from the evil Naght Sieger.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
是你们将我们从邪恶的纳户特基格手中解放出来的。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
Thank you so much. Now we can escape from this cold and dark place... to heaven.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
太感谢了。
我们终于能离开这个阴冷黑暗的地方... 前往天堂。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
Hey, you have the remnants of Naght Sieger with you.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
嘿，你身上带着纳户特基格的残骸。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
They may appear to be one-handed swords, but I can put them together to make a two-handed one if you want. That's the only way I can repay you for freeing me.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
它们看起来是单手剑，不过你愿意的话，我能把它们合成一把双手剑。
这是我报答你解救之恩的唯一办法。

scripts.text: Make a Two-Handed Sword.
scripts.translation: 打造一把双手剑

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
If it is already upgraded or has a card inside, those effects will be disappear. Is this ok with you?
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
如果武器已经精炼或插有卡片，精炼效果和卡片都会消失。
可以接受吗？

scripts.text: It's fine with me. Please make one.
scripts.translation: 没问题，请帮我合成

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 不行

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
Good, then I'll combine these to create a two-handed sword.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
好，我这就把它们合成一把双手剑。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
I see. I guess you aren't as greedy or ambitious as those other adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
我明白了。看来你并不像其他那些冒险者那样贪婪或野心勃勃。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
I see. I guess you aren't as greedy or ambitious as those other adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
我明白了。看来你并不像其他那些冒险者那样贪婪或野心勃勃。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
I'd like to talk to you more, but I've... I've got to go now.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
还想和你多聊一会儿，可我... 我得走了。

scripts.text:
[Lost Souls]
Farewell, young adventurer. I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[迷失的灵魂]
再见了，年轻的冒险者。祝你一路顺风。
